Public, keyless JSON API of AutoPay24hr, a non-KYC crypto swap service. CORS open, HTTPS only. Knowledge source: the documentation page https://autopay24hr.com/api-docs, with every endpoint below probed live on 2026-10-25. This spec deliberately covers only the read-only GET endpoints that work without creating anything: the coin list, pair limits, quotes, chat status and the health check. Left out on purpose: POST /api/v1/order (creates a real swap order with a deposit address), GET /api/v1/order/{id} (needs an order id that only a create returns), POST /api/v1/chat and the WebSocket /ws/order/{id}. Rate limit: anonymous callers get 60 requests per minute per IP (documented, and confirmed by x-ratelimit-limit: 60 / x-ratelimit-reset: 60 response headers). Observed but not documented: pair-limits also returns minNetReceive; quotes also return savePercentVsWorst, minAmount, maxAmount, isEstimate, estimatedTimeTier, cachedAt and expiresAt (epoch milliseconds, quotes are cached for 120 s), a routes array, targetNetToAmount in receive mode, and extra fields on each route; health also returns service, per-check latencyMs and ts. The docs say errors are {"error": {"code", "message"}}; the live API instead returns error as a string code, with message, issues (validation details) or minAmount/maxAmount alongside: 400 `invalid_request` for missing parameters, 400 `amount_too_low` below the route minimum, 404 `no_route` for an unsupported pair. Unverified: the 429 `rate_limited` response body, the full value sets of estimatedTimeTier and providerName, whether a quote can return more than one route, and whether chat status model is null when AI is not configured.
